hook.text: A Hare Krishna gives you a flower at the airport. Now you feel obligated to donate. The free gift was never free.

buildup.text: Reciprocity is the deep human urge to return favors.

discovery.text: Anthropologist Marcel Mauss showed in 1925 that gift exchange is universal across all human cultures.

twist.text: The gift does not have to be big. A small unexpected kindness triggers disproportionate reciprocity.

climax.text: Give first without expecting return. Generosity activates reciprocity naturally.

punchline.text: Give first. Reciprocity handles the rest.

quiz.question: Who showed that gift exchange is universal across cultures?
